_comment: Telegram plugin enablement — passed EXPLICITLY by the daemon via `claude --settings` and ONLY when the launcher owns the poller lock. This must NEVER live in .claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.local.json: any settings-file enablement is auto-loaded by EVERY claude launch in this repo (including plain `claude` and headless --print spawns), which would start a second bridge and steal the single getUpdates poll slot for this bot's token. No secrets here; safe to track in git.
